intro: Snap your plant, measure it, and tell its story. It takes about a minute.

fields.heightHelp: Measure from the soil to the top of the plant.
fields.noteHelp: Try starting with "I noticed…", "I changed…" or "Next I want to try…".
fields.photoHelp: Take a photo of your plant or your build. Leave out faces and names. Photos are saved on this device and sent to the project team.
fields.photoAddHint: Opens your camera or your photos

dashboardIntro: See how your plant has grown. Share it with your family.
emptyText: Measure your plant and add your first entry. Your chart and photos will show up here.
heading: What did you grow today?

announce.adopted: Your earlier entries were added to {name}'s log

savedText: See it below or on your Dashboard.

checklist.help: Tick what you did today. Both are optional.
checklist.soilText: I checked the soil is moist

about.title: About my log
about.intro: Like the cover of your booklet. Fill this in before your first entry.
about.name: My name
about.nameHelp: Use your first name or a nickname. It's saved on this device and sent to the project team with your log.
about.nameError: Enter your first name or a nickname.
about.startDateError: The start date cannot be in the future.
about.switcherHelp: Each person on this device has their own log. Pick your name.
about.deleteText: This deletes {name}'s name, their {count} and photos, and their Sun Day runs from this device. It also removes the name, notes and photos from the project team's copy, and marks the runs as deleted there. Other people's logs stay. You cannot undo this.
about.deleteTip: Tip: save a PDF first if you want to keep a copy.
about.pdfMissingChars: Some characters in the name or plant only show in the app.
